newsitem.title: TAIWAN: China Steel July-Jan pre-tax down 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Steel July-Jan pre-tax down 20 pct.

text.p: China Steel Corp, Taiwan's largest steelmaker, said on Thursday it posted a pre-tax profit of T$9.293 billion between July 1996 and January 1997, down 20 percent from T$11.615 billion from the same period a year ago.
Its sales during the period slid to T$48.951 billion from T$50.500 billion a year earlier, a company statement said.
The company's January pre-tax profit was T$1.355 billion on sales of T$7.374 billion, up from January 1996's pre-tax profit of T$1.264 billion and sales of T$7.120 billion.
China Steel, previously state-run, was privatised in April 1995.
